# Orchestrator Init

Bootstrap this repository using the `repo-context-builder` skill, then register it.

## Skill Loaded
**Required:** Read `skills/repo-context-builder/SKILL.md` and `commands/analyze.md`.
Follow that protocol exactly — this file does not restate it.

## Usage
```
/orchestrator-init
/orchestrator-init --refresh
```

## Output
- `.github/orchestrator-context.md`
- `.github/orchestrator-install.json` — the install state record
- A registry entry in `~/.orchestrator/state/connected-repos.json`

## Notes
Run this before anything else in a new repository. Every other skill reads the context
file, and a pipeline run against an unprofiled repo produces confident guesses at every
phase.
